title: MaveScape experiment design, version 1
description: What each column of a count table is: samples, their roles, conditions and replicates, times or bins, tiles, targets, controls and what the assay measures. Structural rules are here; the rules that depend on the model (two-population, time-series, bins, scores) and on the table are checked by validateDesign in web/lib/design.js. See mavescape-spec/conventions.md, 'Design'.

model.description: two-population: input and output of a selection; time-series: the same library sampled at two or more times; bins: cells sorted into ordered bins; scores: a table of precomputed scores (no counts).

readout.description: What the assay measures (MaveScape 0.2). The method, mechanism and model system are MaveDB's controlled keywords for an experiment (the MAVE minimum information's vocabulary, Claussnitzer et al. 2024). Until the direction is stated, MaveScape takes a higher score to mean more of the function measured, and says so.

phenotype.description: What was measured, in words ("cellular abundance of the domain").

method.description: MaveDB's Phenotypic Assay Method (Reporter, Cell fitness, Binding assay…).

mechanism.description: MaveDB's Phenotypic Assay Mechanism: the variants the assay detects (Loss of function, Gain of function…).

modelSystem.description: MaveDB's Phenotypic Assay Model System (Yeast, Immortalized human cells…).

direction.description: What a higher score means: more of the function measured, less of it, or a larger change either way (no sign).

source.description: Where the table came from, when it is public.

variants.description: The column naming each row's variant, and the level of its names.

level.description: variant: one row per variant; barcode: one row per barcode, each naming the variant it carries (many barcodes per variant).

barcodeColumn.description: For a table of barcodes: the column of barcode identifiers (each on one row).

method.description: How the library was made, in MaveDB's terms (In Vitro Construct Library Method System: Error-prone PCR, Doped oligo synthesis, Oligo pool synthesis…). Libraries made by error-prone PCR or doped oligos reach mostly the substitutions one nucleotide change makes, and coverage is judged against those (MaveScape 0.2).

samples.description: Physical sequenced samples. A sample's columns are its technical replicates, summed before scoring. A sample may be shared by several replicates (one input library selected three times).

replicates.description: Biological replicates (Enrich2's selections): each scored on its own, then combined.

weight.description: What a bin's value means: its rank (1, 2, 3…, or the VAMP-seq weights 0.25–1), a fluorescence, or another measure.

scores.description: For model 'scores': the columns that hold scores and their uncertainty.

wildType.description: 'auto' (p.=, c.=, _wt) or the identifier of the wild-type row

positions.description: Where a class serves as a control, in target positions (MaveScape 0.2): nonsense variants are loss-of-function controls only where a stop loses the function assayed.

why.description: Why each class is a control in this assay, in words (MaveScape 0.2).

ignoredColumns.description: Columns of the table this design does not use, each with the reason, so no column is dropped silently.

copyOf.description: This column repeats another column's values (a shared sample written once per replicate).

codingStart.description: DNA targets: the first base of the reading frame (1-based).

offset.description: Added to target positions to give positions in the reference protein (UniProt numbering).

differences.description: Known differences between the target and the reference (construct changes), so they are not reported as errors.

cells.description: Cells, when known: sorted into this bin; carried into selection from this input; recovered after selection in this output (MaveScape 0.2: quality control checks the bottleneck it infers against them).

missingMeansZero.description: Read this sample's missing counts as 0: for tables that write variants that dropped out during selection as missing rather than 0 (MaveScape 0.2).

lower.description: The bin's lower gate on the reporter (fluorescence, linear units); none for the lowest bin (open). With upper, for the maximum-likelihood estimate (MaveScape 0.2).

upper.description: The bin's upper gate; none for the highest bin (open).
